Exact single-day events can recur daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly through an inclusive until date; missing calendar days are skipped. Projects may designate one StoryBegins and one StoryEnds boundary to drive their timeline span. Other events omit projectBoundary. Optionally link to a world event and same-continuity projects.
